Car off-road

Chassis on R³ × SO(3), four suspension travels and four wheel spins (14 DOF). Terrain, tyre (linear slip, friction circle), suspension and four-wheel-drive forces come from a numeric callback through the virtual work. Wheel spin and steering are not drawn. Rolling hills, washboard and four rocks at up to 6 m/s; wheels leave the ground. The 'Energy change' figure is the work of the tyre, suspension and drive forces. Prototype built with geomech; not part of geomech.systems.

Virtual work:

\[\begin{aligned} \delta W = {}& \left(\delta x + R \widehat{\eta_{R}} r_{fl} + s_{fl} R \widehat{\eta_{R}} e_3 + \delta s_{fl} R e_3\right) \cdot F_{fl} \\ & + \eta_{R} \cdot M_{fl} \\ & + S_{fl} \delta s_{fl} \\ & + \tau_{fl} \delta \phi_{fl} \\ & + \left(\delta x + R \widehat{\eta_{R}} r_{fr} + s_{fr} R \widehat{\eta_{R}} e_3 + \delta s_{fr} R e_3\right) \cdot F_{fr} \\ & + \eta_{R} \cdot M_{fr} \\ & + S_{fr} \delta s_{fr} \\ & + \tau_{fr} \delta \phi_{fr} \\ & + \left(\delta x + R \widehat{\eta_{R}} r_{rl} + s_{rl} R \widehat{\eta_{R}} e_3 + \delta s_{rl} R e_3\right) \cdot F_{rl} \\ & + \eta_{R} \cdot M_{rl} \\ & + S_{rl} \delta s_{rl} \\ & + \tau_{rl} \delta \phi_{rl} \\ & + \left(\delta x + R \widehat{\eta_{R}} r_{rr} + s_{rr} R \widehat{\eta_{R}} e_3 + \delta s_{rr} R e_3\right) \cdot F_{rr} \\ & + \eta_{R} \cdot M_{rr} \\ & + S_{rr} \delta s_{rr} \\ & + \tau_{rr} \delta \phi_{rr} \end{aligned}\]

Equations of motion

E = −(Euler–Lagrange) + forcing; each equation is E = 0, one term per line. S² equations hold on the tangent plane of their point.
